description: Manual review of the CI-green repairs that the automatic F6 classification leaves open (dependency/config class E, test fixes not AST-identical to the original). Single annotator (Claude), 27 Nov 2026, criterion approved the same day; to be declared as in A2. Classes: E-extra = expected fix plus a package the case does not declare; E-touch = other lines changed; E-incoherent = version not coherent with expected_fix; valid/adapted/weakened/incomplete as in A2 §5.5.
